issues.t: Driver's window master switch can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: Burning plastic smell from the driver's door, a warm or melted window switch panel, or windows that stop responding.
issues.why: Rain through an open window or a spilled drink can get into the driver's power window switch, which can then overheat, melt and in rare cases catch fire. Honda recalled these years to fix the switch.
issues.next: Have a Honda dealer check for the open recall now. If you smell burning from the door, stop using the windows and get it inspected before driving further.

issues.t: A/C compressor or compressor clutch failure
issues.sym: A/C blows warm, cools only some of the time, or makes a grinding or clicking noise when switched on.
issues.why: The compressor clutch coil can corrode or the clutch gap can open up, and some compressors fail internally. An internal failure can send metal debris through the rest of the A/C system.
issues.next: Have the A/C diagnosed before replacing parts. A clutch or coil repair is sometimes enough, but after an internal compressor failure the system must be flushed or the new parts can fail too.

issues.t: Rear differential groans on tight turns
issues.sym: A groan, moan or shudder from the back of the car when turning sharply at low speed, such as in a parking lot.
issues.why: On all-wheel-drive models the rear differential fluid wears out, and the clutches inside the rear unit start to grab and chatter.
issues.next: Have the rear differential fluid replaced with Honda's specified fluid. A shop may need to drive figure-eights afterwards to settle the clutches.

issues.t: Rear frame rust can let a trailing arm break loose (recall 23V-228)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, the car pulling or feeling unstable, or heavy rust visible on the rear frame near the suspension.
issues.why: In states that use road salt, de-icing salt can get inside the rear frame and rust it from within. The rear trailing arm mount can weaken and separate, which hurts steering control.
issues.next: Check for the open recall right away, especially in salt-belt states. Do not keep driving with rear clunks or a wandering feel until the frame has been inspected and repaired.

issues.t: Door lock actuators fail
issues.sym: A door will not lock or unlock with the remote or switch, or the lock cycles or buzzes on its own.
issues.why: The small electric motors inside the door lock actuators wear out. Honda issued bulletins for the driver's door and for the other doors.
issues.next: Have the faulty actuator replaced. Ask the dealer whether the related service bulletins apply to your car.

issues.t: Loud rattle for a few seconds on cold start (VTC actuator)
issues.sym: A harsh rattle or grinding noise from the engine for one to three seconds after starting cold, most often in cool weather.
issues.why: The variable valve timing actuator on the camshaft does not hold oil pressure while parked, so it rattles until oil pressure builds. Honda issued a service bulletin to replace the actuator.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer about service bulletin 09-010. Do not ignore it for years, since repeated rattling adds wear to the timing chain.

issues.t: Excessive oil consumption
issues.sym: The oil level drops noticeably between changes, the low oil light may come on, and spark plugs may foul and cause misfires.
issues.why: Carbon deposits can make the oil control piston rings stick, so oil gets past them and burns. Honda issued a bulletin and extended coverage for affected engines.
issues.next: Check the dipstick every few fill-ups and keep records of how much oil you add. Ask a Honda dealer about the oil consumption bulletin.

issues.t: Front door will not open from the inside
issues.sym: Pulling the inside door handle does nothing, though the door opens from outside.
issues.why: The cable from the inside handle to the latch can slip off the handle. Honda issued a service bulletin for it.
issues.next: Have a dealer reattach or replace the handle cable under the bulletin.

issues.t: Vibration at idle
issues.sym: A shake through the seat, floor and steering wheel when stopped in Drive, often worse with the A/C on.
issues.why: The redesigned engine and transmission setup lets low-speed engine vibration reach the cabin. Honda released service bulletins with software and other fixes.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer about service bulletin 15-046 and any later updates. It is a comfort problem, not a safety one.

issues.t: CVT judder or surge on light acceleration
issues.sym: A shudder, surge or vibration when pulling away gently or cruising at light throttle.
issues.why: The continuously variable transmission's control software and fluid behaviour can cause judder. Honda's bulletin updates the software and in some cases replaces the fluid.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer about service bulletin A15-086. Get it checked if the judder grows or the car slips.

issues.t: Fuel in the engine oil (oil dilution)
issues.sym: Oil level above the full mark, a gasoline smell from the dipstick or in the cabin, and weak cabin heat in cold weather.
issues.why: On cold days and short trips the engine does not warm up enough, so unburned fuel slips past the piston rings into the oil. Honda extended the warranty and released software and heater updates for 2017 and 2018 models.
issues.next: Check the dipstick, change oil on time, and ask a Honda dealer whether the software update and extended warranty apply to your car.

issues.t: Automatic emergency braking activates with nothing ahead
issues.sym: The car brakes hard on its own at speed, sometimes with a collision warning, when there is no obstacle.
issues.why: The collision mitigation braking system can misread the road ahead. Federal safety regulators opened an investigation after many owner complaints.
issues.next: Stay alert and keep enough distance from cars behind you. Report each event to Honda and NHTSA, and have the dealer check for camera and radar software updates.

issues.t: A/C stops cooling from a compressor seal leak
issues.sym: The A/C slowly gets weaker and then blows warm air.
issues.why: Oil and refrigerant can leak past the main shaft seal of the A/C compressor. Honda issued a service bulletin for it.
issues.next: Ask a Honda dealer about service bulletin A23-015 and have the A/C checked for leaks.

issues.t: Fuel pump can fail and stall the engine (recall 23V-858)
issues.sym: Rough running, a check-engine light, the engine cutting out while driving, or failure to start.
issues.why: The fuel pump inside the tank can fail on some vehicles. Honda recalled affected cars to replace it.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and have it done soon. If the engine stumbles or stalls, get it to a dealer rather than continuing to drive.

issues.t: Rear subframe can separate (recall 19V-865)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, odd handling, or the car feeling loose at the back.
issues.why: On some early 2020 vehicles the rear subframe may not have been fastened properly and could separate, which hurts handling. Honda recalled them.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN. Do not drive with rear clunks or loose handling until it has been inspected.

issues.t: Front passenger airbag may deploy wrongly (seat weight sensor recall)
issues.sym: The airbag warning light or the passenger airbag off indicator acts oddly, sometimes showing the wrong status for who is in the seat.
issues.why: The front passenger seat weight sensor can fail, so the airbag system may not deploy the bag correctly in a crash. Honda recalled affected vehicles and later expanded the campaign.
issues.next: Check for open recalls 24V-064 and 26V-332 by VIN. Until fixed, have children ride in the back seat.

issues.t: Steering can feel stiff or sticky (recall 24V-744)
issues.sym: The steering feels heavy, sticks slightly or needs extra effort, often around center or at low speed.
issues.why: Parts inside the electric steering gearbox may have been made incorrectly, creating too much internal friction. Honda's fix replaces a spring and redoes the grease.
issues.next: Check for the open recall by VIN and book it soon. If steering becomes hard to turn, stop driving and have it towed in.

issues.t: High-pressure fuel pump can crack and leak (recall 24V-763)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell while parked, idling or driving.
issues.why: The core of the high-pressure fuel pump on some hybrid models can crack and leak fuel, which raises the risk of fire. Honda recalled affected vehicles.
issues.next: If you smell fuel, stop driving and park away from buildings. Check for the open recall by VIN and have it repaired.

issues.t: Burnt exhaust valves from tight valve clearance
issues.sym: A check engine light with misfire codes, a rough idle, hesitation or jerking when pulling away, stalling at stops and a steady loss of power. A compression test often shows one weak cylinder.
issues.why: The valve clearance on this engine tightens as it wears and has to be checked and reset by hand. If that service is skipped, the exhaust valves stop sealing fully, overheat and burn.
issues.next: Get it checked soon. If the valves have never been adjusted, ask for a valve clearance check, which is cheap next to the repair. A burnt valve means a valve job or a replacement cylinder head.

issues.t: Ignition switch can cut out and stall the engine (recall 02V-120)
issues.sym: The engine shuts off without warning while driving, sometimes with the dash lights flickering first, and may restart straight away or after a short wait.
issues.why: Electrical contacts inside the ignition switch wear and can briefly lose connection, which cuts power to the engine. Honda recalled these years to replace the electrical part of the switch.
issues.next: A stall in traffic is a safety problem, so act on it now. Have a Honda dealer check the VIN for the open ignition switch recall, which is repaired free. If the recall was already done and the car still stalls, have the switch tested.

issues.t: Battery goes flat after sitting
issues.sym: Slow cranking or a dead battery after the car sits for a few days, more often in cold weather, sometimes on a battery that is only two or three years old.
issues.why: The factory battery is small for the car, and on some vehicles the A/C compressor relay can stick on and drain it while parked. Honda issued a bulletin to replace that relay.
issues.next: Have the battery load-tested and ask the shop to check for a parasitic drain and for the A/C relay bulletin. A higher-capacity replacement battery helps in cold climates.
